content_sections.heading: About NID Assam
content_sections.text: National Institute of Design Assam is located at Tocklai, Rajabari, Jorhat-785014, and the notice describes it as being under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Govt. of India. The notice is dated 12 November 2026 and is signed by the Chief Administrative Officer (i/c). It is a Hindi and English notice, and Indian nationals may apply.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice prints no department or category-wise break-up for this post.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: M.D. [Medicine] (with valid medical council registration) from a Government recognized Institute / Hospital / Organization affiliated with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council. Eligible Indian Nationals may apply. Retired medical practitioners (from reputed Govt./Private hospitals/Organisations) may apply. The upper age limit is 50 years, and it may be relaxed for deserving candidates. For retired personnel there is no age bar. The notice prints no date for counting age and no minimum age. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.qualification: MBBS (with valid medical council registration) from recognized Institute/College approved by Medical Council of India/State Medical Council
rows.experience: Minimum 3 years working with Government Hospital / reputed and recognised Private Hospitals is mandatory

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay is on a per visit basis, with a minimum of 12 days per month. The pay is usually between Rs 2000 and Rs 3000 per visit. It will be decided depending upon the qualification, experience, duration of duty, etc. The cumulative amount will be paid on a monthly basis. The position is temporary, on contract basis against consolidated pay. Duty hours shall be not less than 03 hours on alternate weekdays, and the officer should be available to address emergencies. The engagement will be initially for 6 (Six) months, which may be extended further on mutual agreement. The Institute reserves the right to amend the terms and conditions of the engagement at any time.

content_sections.heading: NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: To examine and treat patients. Verification of medical bills received as submitted by the institute administration and confirming the eligibility as per extant rules. Maintenance of health records of employees and students. Issue of medical and fitness certificates, and verifying pre-employment medical reports. Handling medical emergencies at any time of the day, and providing first-aid treatment in case of accidents. Follow-up of treatment with hospitals where students, employees or their officially approved dependents are referred or admitted. Any other duties as assigned from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to apply online only, by sending their Bio data / CV and relevant supporting documents (academic and experience) to [email protected] . The email subject must clearly read "Application for the post of Visiting Medical Officer on contract". The application must be submitted by 5:00 PM on 29.11.2026. No other means or mode of application will be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. How many Visiting Medical Officer posts is NID Assam filling?
faq.answer: NID Assam is filling 1 temporary post of Visiting Medical Officer on contract basis against consolidated pay.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application is 29.11.2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS (with valid medical council registration) from a recognized Institute/College approved by Medical Council of India/State Medical Council. A minimum of 3 years' experience in a Government Hospital or reputed and recognised Private Hospitals is mandatory. M.D. [Medicine] is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years, and it may be relaxed for deserving candidates. For retired personnel there is no age bar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Pay is on a per visit basis with a minimum of 12 days per month. It is usually between Rs 2000 and Rs 3000 per visit, decided on qualification, experience, duration of duty, etc., and paid cumulatively on a monthly basis.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Send your Bio data / CV and relevant academic and experience documents to [email protected]. Write the subject as "Application for the post of Visiting Medical Officer on contract". No other mode of application will be accepted.

faq.question: Q7. Can retired doctors apply for the NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired medical practitioners from reputed Govt./Private hospitals/Organisations may apply, and for retired personnel there is no age bar.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary position on contract basis, initially for 6 (Six) months, which may be extended further on mutual agreement.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA / DA will be admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the duty hours for the NID Assam Visiting Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Duty hours shall be not less than 03 hours on alternate weekdays, and the officer should be available to address emergencies.
